Name: Joseph, Son of Asaph
Summary: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph, first lot for Asaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:2; 1 Chronicles 25:9: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph, first lot for Asaph.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joseph stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
